tree.heading: Labor attaché
tree.text: The term “labor attaché” means an individual hired under part B.

tree.heading: Labor obligations
tree.text: The term “labor obligations” means the obligations under chapter 23 of the USMCA (relating to labor).

tree.heading: Mexico’s labor reform
tree.text: The term “Mexico’s labor reform” means the legislation on labor reform enacted by Mexico on May 1, 2019.
